name: Polestar: guide steps that sent you to a rare
author: github:ubermuda
description: Five written guide steps named a rare mob as the item's source, though ordinary mobs nearby drop it too: Chen's Empty Keg (Horde), Claim Rackmore's Treasure! (both), Rhapsody's Kalimdor Kocktail and Flute of Xavaric (Alliance). They now name the ordinary mobs, and every mob that drops the item is on the step's target list. Waypoints are unchanged.
